specification_note: DGP uses 2x sigma (6.0). Model paths use true sigma. Intervals are too narrow. Expected: bilateral over-breaching, RED. PIT should show U-shaped histogram (heavy tails relative to model).
samples_note: Samples are model paths (well-specified Gaussian). PIT = P(model_sample <= misspecified_realisation) — non-uniform PIT reveals the misspecification.
